cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Brighter Side
cards.instruction: Meet every setback with even greater optimism.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No tickets sold! Perfect: I can finish teaching you to project before anyone hears our play.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The theatre has cancelled us. They want the stage cleared.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Even better. You're ready to stop relying on walls to carry your voice. We'll hire the pub upstairs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They kept our deposit. All we can afford is the bus home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful, your first touring show! Start quietly at the back, like I taught you; by the next stop you'll have reached the whole bus.

reason: Make each lost venue a claimed graduation in projection, with the remaining bus fare causing a specific mobile-audience exercise.
